term: Smart speaker industry in South Korea
definition: Smart speakers, or AI speakers, have been developed by multiple domestic electronics and telecommunications firms in South Korea.
details: Since their introduction to the local market in 2016, they have been used by millions of people in the country.

explainer.lead: Smart speakers, or AI speakers, have been developed by multiple domestic electronics and telecommunications firms in South Korea. Since their 2016 market introduction they have been used by millions of people there.

tiers.eli5: Several Korean electronics and telecom companies make talking speakers for homes, and lots of people in the country use them.
tiers.practitioner: Analysts studying this market track the involvement of domestic electronics and telecommunications firms and the size of the user base. The available facts cover adoption and origin, not device internals.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition; the term denotes the South Korean market segment for AI speakers developed by domestic electronics and telecommunications firms since 2016.

explainer.example: A Korean household using an AI speaker made by a domestic electronics or telecom firm illustrates the market's adoption.

citation.title: Smart speaker industry in South Korea
